SUBSTITUTE
PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE-1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT AT
2600-2610 NORTH CLARK STREET

The Applicant requests a zoning change for the property located at 2600-2610 North Clark Street
(the “Property”) from the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District to the B3-5 Community
Shopping District in order to construct a seven (7) story, eighty (80.0) foot tall, transit-oriented,
mixed-use building with sixty-six (66) dwelling units on the 2 through 7" floors, and ten (10)
automobile parking spaces, and sixty-six (66) bicycle parking spaces and approximately 3,732
square feet of commercial space on the ground floor (the “Project”).

The Property is bordered by North Clark Street to the east, West Wrightwood Avenue to the
south, a public alley to the north, and abuts property zoned RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
to the west.

The Property is along the #22/Clark Street CTA bus route (“Clark Street Bus”), which is a CTA
bus line corridor roadway segment listed on Table 17-17-0400-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance (the “Ordinance”) and, accordingly, is a Transit Served Location. Because of the
Property’s location on the Clark Street Bus line, the maximum percentage for efficiency units set
forth in Section 17-3-0410-A of the Ordinance does not apply here. The proposed development
is also subject to the Pedestrian Street Standards of Section 17-3-0500 of the Ordinance.
